source.symbol: Exchange advanced URL control and accessible label
source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
<!-- EWS Panel -->
      <vbox id="ewsPanel">
        <hbox align="center">
          <label
            id="exchangeUrlLabel"
            data-l10n-id="ews-url-label"
            control="exchangeUrl"
          />
          <hbox flex="1" class="input-container">
            <html:input
              id="exchangeUrl"
              type="text"
              class="input-inline"
              aria-labelledby="exchangeUrlLabel"
              amsa_persist="true"
            />
          </hbox>
        </hbox>
        <vbox id="exchangeOverrideOAuthDetailsContainer">
          <separator class="groove" />
          <checkbox
            id="exchangeOverrideOAuthDetails"
            amsa_persist="true"
            data-l10n-id="ews-override-oauth-details"
            oncommand="onChangeExchangeOAuthOverride(this)"
          />
